name: dot-board
title: Dot Board
description: A departures board of LED dots whose lines light in a left-to-right sweep when their text changes.

perf.budget: One Skia canvas; the dots are prebuilt paths and the sweep only moves a clip on the UI thread. Nothing animates at rest.

measurements.notes: Frames at rest come from the demo, which changes departure every 4 s. A board with unchanged text draws nothing.

a11y.reducedMotion: Dots appear lit at once, with no sweep.
a11y.screenReader: The title, subtitle and every line read as one label ("Next Departure. Your ride leaves from gate twelve. 08:45. KYOTO. NZ204").

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { DotBoard } from '@/components/kinetik/dot-board';

<DotBoard
  title="Next Departure"
  subtitle="Your ride leaves from gate twelve."
  lines={[
    '08:45',
    [{ text: 'KYOTO', color: amber }],
    [{ text: 'NZ', color: amber }, { text: '204' }],
  ]}
/>;
```

## When to use

- One short, glanceable status: a departure, a score, a queue number, a countdown.
- A place where a bit of hardware character suits the product.

## When not to use

- Long text. Each line holds about nine characters at this size.
- Languages outside A to Z: the dot font has no accents or other scripts, and unknown characters stay blank.

## Notes

- A line is a string, or runs with their own colours.
- Change a line's text and only that line lights up again.
- `columns` sets the width of the board; dots shrink to fit, so keep it low on small cards.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add dot-board`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
